t: You're looking at a memorial to Rabindranath Tagore in Gordon Square. It includes a likeness of him, made by the British painter and sculptor Shenda Amery. Tagore was a Bengali poet, author, composer and philosopher, and one of the leading figures of the Bengal Renaissance. In 1913 he became the first non-European to win a Nobel Prize, receiving the prize for literature. He also wrote the national anthems of both India and Bangladesh.
